options: 1 (recommended). ElevenLabs: one Oupa voice speaking all three languages, Afrikaans included; a paid monthly plan; you either generate the clips from my script or add an API key as a secret
2. Microsoft Azure voices: a proper Afrikaans man (Willem), a South African English man (Luke) and German voices; a free monthly allowance; three different voices, not one Oupa

needsYou.answer: 27 Oct: first finish building the game so all the text is known; then one voice job. Likely an OpenRouter API key (stored as an environment secret, never in chat): speech generation plus an automatic speech-to-text check of every clip, after a short Afrikaans sample test.
